Full width or boxed layout options
Customizable spacing, background, and text color
shortDescription: The Buy Box is a container block that orchestrates the product purchase experience on the PDP. It houses multiple child blocks including Basic Product Info, Price, Variant Selection, Stock Information, Benefits Box, Coupon Box, and Energy Label—each toggleable based on merchant needs. The container manages consistent spacing between blocks and offers layout choices between full-width and boxed styles with customizable backgrounds. This modular approach allows flexible Buy Box configurations.
